links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified online surgical patient education materials
links.outcome: Readability (SMOG index; also Coleman-Liau, Flesch-Kincaid, word count) of surgical patient education materials
links.effect: Mean SMOG decreased from 12.1 to 10.5 (P < 10^-9); Coleman-Liau -0.8 (P < 10^-5); Flesch-Kincaid -1.6 (P < 10^-8); word count reduced 55% on average (plastic surgery 66%, P = 0.008); accuracy maintained in all specialties
links.tradeoff: Key content such as risks and benefits was often omitted; the sixth-grade target was not reached (mean SMOG still 10.5)
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o simplification significantly decreased mean Simple Measure of Gobbledygook score from 12.1 to 10.5 (P < 10-9), with similar reductions in Coleman-Liau index (-0.8, P < 10-5) and Flesch-Kincaid (-1.6, P < 10-8).

links.comparator_used: Original unsimplified materials (no prompt-free LLM arm was compared)
links.outcome: Readability after prompting ChatGPT-4o to simplify to sixth-grade level
links.effect: Mean SMOG 12.1 to 10.5 (P < 10^-9); Flesch-Kincaid -1.6; Coleman-Liau -0.8; sixth-grade target not achieved
links.tradeoff: Key content such as risks and benefits was often omitted; achieving the sixth grade level may be challenging due to inherent complexity of medical information
links.quote: Achieving the recommended sixth grade reading level may be challenging due to the inherent complexity of medical information.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt with expert clinician review
